pois.name: 14th Political Prison
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Walled plateau with a watchtower on every corner and the Y-shaped Citadel in the yard. The Warden holds the mess hall with a riot shield.

pois.name: Chang-san Air Base
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Air base built into a granite hillside, with an underground bunker that is bigger than the base above it. Operation Iron Citadel runs through it.

pois.name: Deadtown
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Deserted NK farming town with a clinic, a bounty station and a Lieutenant Hunt Tower. Bale holds the Re-Education Center.

pois.name: Imjin Farmland
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Rice fields, farms and rail lines around the big Rice Mill on the border between North and South. Also a Multiplayer Combat Outpost map.

pois.name: Cheongun Village
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: The northernmost South Korean village, split by the border crossing to Russia. The Heavenly Luck Casino is here, and so is Jin-Tae.

pois.name: Haneul Nuclear Reactor
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Reactor island with heavy radiation, worst inside the facility. Bring radiation gear and a gas mask. The Chemist spawns here and Operation Fallen Ember goes inside.

pois.name: Mirae General Hospital
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: The main hospital of Hajin, with triage tents and military barracks around it, next to a train station on the edge of the city. The Doctor waits in the parking garage.

pois.name: NuriGO Mall
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Shopping district with a courtyard, light wells and an elevator down to the underground mall. There is no power down there, so bring NVGs. We ran into the Deathstalker Commander around here.

pois.name: Cheonwang Peak Array
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: The biggest telecom array in Hajin, on a flat summit surrounded by forest and boulders. Iskra holds it, and Gorani roams the woods to the south.

pois.name: The Grid
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Walled business district with DBN Headquarters (Roze), the Netshin Tech Complex (Jang-ui, 15th floor) and the Hanex Bank tower. The toughest part of Hajin City.

pois.name: Songdo Wharf
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Quiet wharf on the east side of Hajin City, between the reactor and the south fork of the river.

pois.name: Wolves Stadium
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Baseball stadium district with a police station, a clinic and Compound Echo nearby. Also a Multiplayer Combat Outpost map.

pois.name: Hajin River Heights
pois.label: Major Location
pois.text: Residential blocks and narrow shopping streets in the south of Hajin City, home of The Scavenger.

pois.name: The Citadel
pois.label: Stronghold
pois.text: Y-shaped stronghold in the prison yard with gantries, cell blocks, a furnace and high-value targets. One of the most dangerous spots in Hajin.

pois.name: Heavenly Luck Casino
pois.label: Stronghold
pois.text: Multi-floor casino with gambling halls and an underground car park without power. Jin-Tae spawns here, and a DMZ Order asks you to mark 10 enemies inside with a Recon Drone.

pois.name: Admin Complex No. 2
pois.label: Stronghold
pois.text: The fortified heart of Chang-san Air Base. The bunker below is Extreme threat, and Operation Iron Citadel takes you through it.

pois.name: Re-Education Center
pois.label: Stronghold
pois.text: Bale's stronghold in Deadtown, a step up from the rest of the town.

pois.name: Rice Mill
pois.label: Stronghold
pois.text: Industrial mill that towers over Imjin Farmland and gives a long view across the fields.

pois.label: Lieutenant
pois.text: 14th Political Prison, in the mess hall. Fights with a riot shield.

keys.name: Air Base DRC Weapons Locker
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the yellow and blue DRC locker in The Armory of the Chang-san Air Base Bunker, the same armory Operation Iron Citadel ends in. The armory door needs the six digit code from the three notes in the bunker, and that code changes every match. 3-Plate Helmet Armor and a weapon manual were inside.
keys.sub: Key: field loot (ours came from a duffel in Imjin Farmland). Door and prompt confirmed on video (Five Star General Clips).

keys.name: Bank Branch Vault Access (north Songdo Wharf)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: The keycard for the vault of a Hanex Bank branch. It spawns inside the bank. Put a car battery in the sparking power panel, swipe the card at the vault door, then enter the four digit code: a note in the bank gives the first three digits and you try the last one. Two branches are on the map: north Songdo Wharf and the branch next to the gas station below Wolves Stadium; a third is reported in Cheongun Village.
keys.sub: No fixed code exists. Counts for the order Find a Way Inside the Vault. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Incredilags).

keys.name: Blackmarket Weapons Locker (Hanrim Village)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens one of the two weapons lockers in the basement back room of a Blackmarket. There is one in south Deadtown and one in Hanrim Village, the northernmost suburb. Expect an Epic or Rare weapon with attachments.
keys.sub: Key: Recon Equipment Kit (Survival Kit), also field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

keys.name: Blackmarket Weapons Locker (south Deadtown)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens one of the two weapons lockers in the basement back room of a Blackmarket. There is one in south Deadtown and one in Hanrim Village, the northernmost suburb. Expect an Epic or Rare weapon with attachments.
keys.sub: Key: Recon Equipment Kit (Survival Kit), also field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Christian Konopatzki).

keys.name: Coin Mining Den
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the e-coin mining lab in NuriGO West, the apartment block directly east of the westernmost gas station inside NuriGO Mall. South stairwell with the red railings, landing marked 3, grey door with a handle under the Office sign. Server racks, computers and crafting parts such as CPUs and circuit boards, no weapons.
keys.sub: Key: reward of Operation Shopping Hacks. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Commandant Office
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the commandant's office on the second floor of Admin Complex No. 2 at Chang-san Air Base. North front door, stairs at the back, upstairs left, first door on the left under the Conference Room sign. Rifle case, up to five lockers with Epic weapons and an equipment case.
keys.sub: Key: field loot (ours came from a jacket in Cheongun Outskirts). Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Counting Room Vault
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the Counting Room on the main floor of the Heavenly Luck Casino: in through the south lobby, right into the east wing, the door marked Counting Room at the end of the corridor. The keypad next to the inner door does nothing, the key opens both doors. Inside: a foot locker, a weapon crate, two stacked safes and cash.
keys.sub: Key: reward of Operation Silent Ledger, also drops as field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Executive Arms Auction
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the weapons auction room high up in DBN Headquarters, the tallest tower in The Grid. Reported to hold weapon cases; nobody has filmed the inside in detail yet.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Braden).

keys.name: Field Depot
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the gear maintenance room on the first floor of the military supply warehouse at Chang-san Air Base. Only the door has been seen so far.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Christian Konopatzki).

keys.name: Gangbyeon Apartment B
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the glass double doors of apartment block B at Hajin River Heights, the stronghold with the SAM site on the roof. The key is reported to spawn loose inside apartment A next door.
keys.sub: Key: field loot in apartment A. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Gas Station Electrical Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the electrical room in the basement of the gas station on the south side of the Construction Zone, below the Hanwoori Design Complex.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

dexerto.location: Basement of the gas station in the construction zone between The Grid and Songdo Wharf

keys.name: Gun Store Weapons Locker (west Cheongun Village)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens one of the three green weapons lockers in a gun store basement. There are two gun stores: west Cheongun Village, across the street from the police station, and north Songdo Wharf, the shop with the red front. One key opens one locker and gives one weapon with attachments.
keys.sub: Key: Trap Equipment Kit and Explosives Equipment Kit (Survival Kits), also field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Gamers Heroes).

dexerto.how_to_get: Explosives Equipment Kit (DMZ level 16), Trap Equipment Kit (DMZ level 42)

keys.name: Gun Store Weapons Locker (north Songdo Wharf)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens one of the three green weapons lockers in a gun store basement. There are two gun stores: west Cheongun Village, across the street from the police station, and north Songdo Wharf, the shop with the red front. One key opens one locker and gives one weapon with attachments.
keys.sub: Key: Trap Equipment Kit and Explosives Equipment Kit (Survival Kits), also field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (KinneyA32).

dexerto.how_to_get: Explosives Equipment Kit (DMZ level 16), Trap Equipment Kit (DMZ level 42)

keys.name: Haejeok Radio Station
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the broadcasting room on level 1 of the northernmost relay station in Imjin Farmland: the white transmitter building with the garage door under the red mast. Server racks and tech loot.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. We hold this key in our stash. Door and prompt confirmed on video (xGarbett).

keys.name: Haksan School Armory
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the improvised armory, a tiled classroom on the second floor of the school in Deadtown. A Counting Room Vault key was once found in a locker here.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (xGarbett).

keys.name: Hanex Guard Station
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the guard room one floor below the roof of the Hanex Bank tower in The Grid, between two vault rooms. Stairs or a zipline get you up. Two weapon lockers, a safe, an equipment case and high tier weapons. The bank vault itself is not a key lock: it needs a car battery, the Bank Branch Vault Access keycard and a code.
keys.sub: Key: field loot, no fixed spawn known. Door and prompt confirmed on video (ZandomGaming).

keys.name: Hanwoori Art Records Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the records room on the first floor of the Hanwoori Design Complex, the southeast building of The Grid with the SAM site. Take the south Grid entrance, the building on the left, stairs to the north main entrance, then the back door on the left. Rifle case, military bag, foot lockers, filing cabinets and an equipment case.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. We hold this key in our stash. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Hazard Storehouse
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the storage shed next to the SAM site on the south side of the reactor island. Up to eleven lockers with grenades and chemical cabinets were reported. Sources disagree on the grid, I4, I5 or I7, so we check the square in game.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Hoesik Supply Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the military supply closet upstairs in the southernmost office building at the Rice Mill in Imjin Farmland.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Imjin Mill Foreman's Office
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the foreman's office on the first floor of the Rice Mill in Imjin Farmland.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

keys.name: Iskra's Control Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Lieutenant Iskra's room on the top floor of the transmitter building at Cheonwang Peak Array. Listed by the key databases; no video shows the key dropping yet.
keys.sub: Key: drops from Iskra. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Major Help).

keys.name: Jang-ui's Converted Power Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Lieutenant Jang-ui's room: the converted generator room on the lowest floor of NuriGO Mall, next to the robodog course. Two weapon lockers, a loot chest and the Lieutenant crate.
keys.sub: Key: drops from Jang-ui. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

dexerto.location: Opens the enclosed generator room beside NuriGO Mall's Robo Dog agility course.

keys.name: Jin-Tae's Private Lounge
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Lieutenant Jin-Tae's lounge in the casino penthouse. The lobby lift only runs once the generator in the parking garage is on. His Lieutenant crate with two legendary weapons sits inside, which completes the Keep Out order.
keys.sub: Key: drops from Jin-Tae, the casino Lieutenant. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Kang's Arms Incinerator
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Lieutenant Kang's room in the central block of the 14th Political Prison, named in one video. Rarity and contents unknown.
keys.sub: Key: drops from the Warden, Kang. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Lucera Suite 703 Bedroom
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the bedroom inside suite 703 of Hotel Lucera, next to the Hanex Bank tower. The suite is open, only the bedroom is locked. Stairs to floor 12 and one more flight, or the zipline in the lift shaft, then rooms 702 and 703. Rifle case, supply crate and weapons lockers.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

dexerto.location: 13th floor of the Hotel Lucera in The Grid

keys.name: Mechanic's Shack
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the stand alone shed with a single white door directly south of the Cheongun Village clinic. Medium backpack, a sniper and plates were reported inside.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Militia Arms Depot
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the arms room on the bottom floor of Gangbyeon Apartment B in Compound Echo at Hajin River Heights.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Braden).

dexerto.how_to_get: Duffel bag in The Citadel's East Wing (not guaranteed)

keys.name: Mill Explosives Lab
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the explosives lab at the Rice Mill. The exact door is not confirmed yet.
keys.sub: Key: field loot.

keys.name: Mirae Electrical Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the electrical room on level B2 of the northwest parking garage of Mirae General Hospital. From the ring road, slide under the half closed roller door with the P sign, go to the lowest level and the grey double doors at the back past the servers. Tool chests, military bags, armor boxes and a medium weapon backpack.
keys.sub: Key: reward of Operation Critical Extraction, also field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

keys.name: Netshin IT Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the secured server room on floor 14 of the Netshin Tech Complex, behind the main server hall. A weapons locker and a lot of server blades, which are comms modules for crafting.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Old Barber Shop
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the old barber shop next to the crab stall on the south side of Songdo Wharf. Weapon cases and armor boxes were reported.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Police Station Armory (Pyeonghwa Village)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the caged armory on the ground floor of a police station. The key usually spawns inside the same station, on a desk upstairs or behind the reception. Every police station has an armory; whether one key opens every station is something we are testing.
keys.sub: Key: spawns inside the police station, also in the Recon Equipment Kit.

keys.name: Police Station Armory (Revolution Dam)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the caged armory on the ground floor of a police station. The key usually spawns inside the same station, on a desk upstairs or behind the reception. Every police station has an armory; whether one key opens every station is something we are testing.
keys.sub: Key: spawns inside the police station, also in the Recon Equipment Kit.

keys.name: Police Station Armory (Cheongun Village)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the caged armory on the ground floor of a police station. The key usually spawns inside the same station, on a desk upstairs or behind the reception. Every police station has an armory; whether one key opens every station is something we are testing.
keys.sub: Key: spawns inside the police station, also in the Recon Equipment Kit. Door and prompt confirmed on video (LaserBolt).

keys.name: Police Station Armory (Hajin City east)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the caged armory on the ground floor of a police station. The key usually spawns inside the same station, on a desk upstairs or behind the reception. Every police station has an armory; whether one key opens every station is something we are testing.
keys.sub: Key: spawns inside the police station, also in the Recon Equipment Kit.

keys.name: Police Station Armory (Wolves Stadium)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the caged armory on the ground floor of a police station. The key usually spawns inside the same station, on a desk upstairs or behind the reception. Every police station has an armory; whether one key opens every station is something we are testing.
keys.sub: Key: spawns inside the police station, also in the Recon Equipment Kit.

keys.name: Police Weapon Depository
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the white garage building with the green roller door next to the Wolves Stadium police station. Lockers with Epic weapons were reported inside.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Prison Encampment Storage
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the ordnance storage on the southeast side of the prison camp at the 14th Political Prison.
keys.sub: Key: field loot (ours came from a duffel in Imjin Farmland).

keys.name: Rail Depot Storage
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the storage room in the basement of the train depot next to the Cheongun Village fire station. Lockers, cases and cash were reported inside. Some sites call it Train Depot Storage Room.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Christian Konopatzki).

keys.name: Re-Education Center Annex
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the small annex on the ground floor of the Re-Education Center, the largest building in Deadtown. Go in at the south corner and follow the wall to the left. A legendary Odin and a 2-Plate Ballistic Gel Vest blueprint were found inside.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. We hold this key in our stash. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

keys.name: Reactor 02 Control Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the control room on the upper inner catwalk of Reactor 02. Listed by the key databases; we have not seen the door yet.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Braden).

dexerto.location: Opens the control room inside the Reactor 02 building within Haneul Nuclear Reactor.

keys.name: Reactor DRC Locker
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the DRC locker under water in the irradiated pool of Reactor 02, the round building. Bring a hazmat suit or gas masks. It opens an Elite Weapons Locker with a weapon manual, an Epic weapon and a 3-plate vest in the runs we checked.
keys.sub: Key: reward of Operation Fallen Ember. Door and prompt confirmed on video (P Humble).

keys.name: Roze's Highrise Armory
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the armory on floor 14 of the Netshin Tech Complex, a teal door without a sign on the east side. Extreme threat with robodogs and turrets, so barricade the door. A Lieutenant crate and two weapon lockers.
keys.sub: Key: reward of Operation Grid Assault, also a drop from Lieutenant Roze. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

keys.name: Shop Records Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the records room above the Goh24 supermart just south of the Wolves Stadium clinic. Take the green outside stairs up; the frosted glass door is at the top. A duffel with documents and lockers were reported inside.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. We hold this key in our stash. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TopAzn).

keys.name: Shopping DRC Locker
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the DRC locker in the DRC Labs, deep in the high security lower parking garage under NuriGO Mall where Operation Shopping Hacks ends. The lab door takes 8 to 10 robodog cores first. DRC lockers are called Elite Weapons Locker in game.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Schlayer).

keys.name: Supreme Leader's Bunker Access Card
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the big grey blast door of the Supreme Leader's Bunker deep under Chang-san Air Base. Solo route: the notch on the west edge of the base, crawl through the bushes, ladder, the Entrance door, right, bay door, door with the red banner, right, stairwell all the way down. Inside: the Supreme Leader's rooms, a locker corridor and a Lieutenant crate with legendary weapons. Single use.
keys.sub: Key: reward of Operation Iron Citadel (chapter Hornet's Nest); counts as Bale's Lieutenant key. Door and prompt confirmed on video (GmackZilla).

dexerto.how_to_get: Reward for completing the Operation Iron Citadel mission story.

keys.name: The Chemist's Secure Armory
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Lieutenant The Chemist's room: the right hand one of two bunker doors along the north reactor road by the boathouse. The left door is free. Rifle case, crate and two weapon lockers.
keys.sub: Key: drops from The Chemist. Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: The Citadel South Wing
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the exterior door of the south wing of The Citadel, the Y-shaped fort in the middle of the prison. The cell doors inside have their own keypad puzzle.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Mr ZEUS OK).

keys.name: The Doctor's Command Office
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Lieutenant The Doctor's room on floor 7 of Mirae General Hospital, sign Office 701 to 712, light wooden double doors. The Lieutenant crate held the Tempered Armor Vest recipe in the runs we checked.
keys.sub: Key: drops from The Doctor. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Underground Propaganda Store Room
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the blue door in the cell block of the Re-Education Center basement in Deadtown.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Christian Konopatzki).

keys.name: Utility Maintenance Storage
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the maintenance room beneath the transformer yard next to Reactor 01 at Haneul Nuclear Reactor. Lockers and crates inside; only one short video exists, so we are checking the exact door today.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. We hold this key in our stash. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Braden).

keys.name: Vault Armory
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the caged armory in the underground parking of the Heavenly Luck Casino. North entrance, right into the west wing, double doors at the back down to the garage, the room at the foot of the northwest stairs. Armor box, weapon case, two weapons lockers, a medium backpack and server blades.
keys.sub: Key: field loot (ours came from a duffel in Songdo Wharf). Door and prompt confirmed on video (TroubleChute Basics).

keys.name: Weapons Mod Workshop
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the weapons workshop on the second floor of the military repair garage at Chang-san Air Base.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Major Help).

dexerto.location: Opens the weapons workshop on floor 2 of the military repair garage at Chang-san Air Base.

keys.name: Bank Branch Vault Access (Wolves Stadium branch)
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: The keycard for the vault of a Hanex Bank branch. It spawns inside the bank. Put a car battery in the sparking power panel, swipe the card at the vault door, then enter the four digit code: a note in the bank gives the first three digits and you try the last one. Two branches are on the map: north Songdo Wharf and the branch next to the gas station below Wolves Stadium; a third is reported in Cheongun Village.
keys.sub: No fixed code exists. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Incredilags).

keys.name: Gangbyeon Apartment A
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the locked door of apartment block A at Hajin River Heights, next to block B. Seen on video with the prompt Gangbyeon Apartment A - Locked; rarity not read yet. The key for block B is reported to spawn inside A.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

keys.name: Hotel Lucera Lobby
keys.label: Key and Intel
keys.text: Opens the glass street door into the lobby of Hotel Lucera. The prompt Hotel Lucera Lobby - Locked confirms the key exists; we have not read its tooltip yet. Inside the hotel, suite 703 has its own bedroom key.
keys.sub: Key: field loot. Door and prompt confirmed on video (Kasum Adventurer).

B3.name: The Citadel
B3.label: Stronghold
B3.text: Y-shaped stronghold in the prison yard with gantries, cell blocks, a furnace and high-value targets. One of the most dangerous spots in Hajin.

B3.name: The Warden
B3.label: Lieutenant
B3.text: 14th Political Prison, in the mess hall. Fights with a riot shield.

B3.name: UAV Tower
B3.label: UAV Tower
B3.text: Activate it for a side op, DMZ Cash and a pulse that reveals nearby Operators and enemies. The Scout trait Overwatch keeps it running.

B3.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
B3.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
B3.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

B3.name: Kang's Arms Incinerator
B3.label: Key and Intel
B3.text: Lieutenant Kang's room in the central block of the 14th Political Prison, named in one video. Rarity and contents unknown.

B3.name: The Citadel South Wing
B3.label: Key and Intel
B3.text: Opens the exterior door of the south wing of The Citadel, the Y-shaped fort in the middle of the prison. The cell doors inside have their own keypad puzzle.

B3.name: The Warden
B3.label: Lieutenant
B3.place: 14th Political Prison, in the mess hall. Fights with a riot shield
B3.text: 14th Political Prison, in the mess hall. Fights with a riot shield

B4.name: Compound Foxtrot
B4.label: Compound
B4.text: Fortified military position with tougher enemies, better loot and often an armored vehicle. Clearing one counts for Clear a Compound in DMZ Orders.

B4.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
B4.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
B4.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

B5.name: Chang-san Air Base
B5.label: Major Location
B5.text: Air base built into a granite hillside, with an underground bunker that is bigger than the base above it. Operation Iron Citadel runs through it.

B5.name: Admin Complex No. 2
B5.label: Stronghold
B5.text: The fortified heart of Chang-san Air Base. The bunker below is Extreme threat, and Operation Iron Citadel takes you through it.

B5.name: UAV Tower
B5.label: UAV Tower
B5.text: Activate it for a side op, DMZ Cash and a pulse that reveals nearby Operators and enemies. The Scout trait Overwatch keeps it running.

B5.name: SAM Site
B5.label: SAM Site
B5.text: SAM site at Chang-san Air Base, marked in orange on the tac map. Capture one for a side op. Operation Iron Citadel asks you to capture one.

B5.name: SAM Site
B5.label: SAM Site
B5.text: SAM site at Chang-san Air Base, marked in orange on the tac map. Capture one for a side op. Operation Iron Citadel asks you to capture one.

B5.name: Clinic
B5.label: Clinic
B5.text: Small clinic with a green facade and medical loot. DMZ Orders page 2 asks you to head to one.

B5.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
B5.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
B5.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

B5.name: Commandant Office
B5.label: Key and Intel
B5.text: Opens the commandant's office on the second floor of Admin Complex No. 2 at Chang-san Air Base. North front door, stairs at the back, upstairs left, first door on the left under the Conference Room si

B5.label: Key and Intel
B5.text: Opens the gear maintenance room on the first floor of the military supply warehouse at Chang-san Air Base. Only the door has been seen so far.

B5.name: Weapons Mod Workshop
B5.label: Key and Intel
B5.text: Opens the weapons workshop on the second floor of the military repair garage at Chang-san Air Base.

B6.name: Lost Supply Drop 1
B6.label: Lost Supply Drop
B6.text: A fixed Lost Supply Drop spot. Not every spot has a drop in every match. Look for red smoke and an orange parachute.

B6.name: SAM Site
B6.label: SAM Site
B6.text: SAM site at Chang-san Air Base, marked in orange on the tac map. Capture one for a side op. Operation Iron Citadel asks you to capture one.

B6.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
B6.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
B6.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

B6.name: Air Base DRC Weapons Locker
B6.label: Key and Intel
B6.text: Opens the yellow and blue DRC locker in The Armory of the Chang-san Air Base Bunker, the same armory Operation Iron Citadel ends in. The armory door needs the six digit code from the three notes in th

B6.name: Supreme Leader's Bunker Access Card
B6.label: Key and Intel
B6.text: Opens the big grey blast door of the Supreme Leader's Bunker deep under Chang-san Air Base. Solo route: the notch on the west edge of the base, crawl through the bushes, ladder, the Entrance door, rig

B7.name: Deadtown
B7.label: Major Location
B7.text: Deserted NK farming town with a clinic, a bounty station and a Lieutenant Hunt Tower. Bale holds the Re-Education Center.

B7.name: Re-Education Center
B7.label: Stronghold
B7.text: Bale's stronghold in Deadtown, a step up from the rest of the town.

B7.name: Lieutenant Hunt Tower
B7.label: Lieutenant Hunt Tower
B7.text: Climb it and use the terminal at the top to mark the nearest Lieutenant on your map. A DMZ Order on page 2 asks for one.

B7.name: UAV Tower
B7.label: UAV Tower
B7.text: Activate it for a side op, DMZ Cash and a pulse that reveals nearby Operators and enemies. The Scout trait Overwatch keeps it running.

B7.name: Clinic
B7.label: Clinic
B7.text: Small clinic with a green facade and medical loot. DMZ Orders page 2 asks you to head to one.

B7.name: Bounty Station
B7.label: Bounty Station
B7.text: Bounty station in Deadtown, marked with a money bag and a skull on the tac map.

B7.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
B7.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
B7.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

B7.name: Gas Station
B7.label: Gas Station
B7.text: Repair and refuel cars and helicopters, and fill Gas Cans. A DMZ Order on page 8 sends you to one.

B7.name: Blackmarket Weapons Locker (south Deadtown)
B7.label: Key and Intel
B7.text: Opens one of the two weapons lockers in the basement back room of a Blackmarket. There is one in south Deadtown and one in Hanrim Village, the northernmost suburb. Expect an Epic or Rare weapon with a

B7.name: Haksan School Armory
B7.label: Key and Intel
B7.text: Opens the improvised armory, a tiled classroom on the second floor of the school in Deadtown. A Counting Room Vault key was once found in a locker here.

B7.name: Re-Education Center Annex
B7.label: Key and Intel
B7.text: Opens the small annex on the ground floor of the Re-Education Center, the largest building in Deadtown. Go in at the south corner and follow the wall to the left. A legendary Odin and a 2-Plate Ballis

B7.name: Underground Propaganda Store Room
B7.label: Key and Intel
B7.text: Opens the blue door in the cell block of the Re-Education Center basement in Deadtown.

C2.name: Fire Station
C2.label: Fire Station
C2.text: Brick in the North, modern in the South, with enemies inside. DMZ Orders page 7 asks you to locate one.

C2.name: Marine Gas Station
C2.label: Gas Station
C2.text: Jetty with two pumps to repair and refuel boats.

C2.name: Blackmarket Weapons Locker (Hanrim Village)
C2.label: Key and Intel
C2.text: Opens one of the two weapons lockers in the basement back room of a Blackmarket. There is one in south Deadtown and one in Hanrim Village, the northernmost suburb. Expect an Epic or Rare weapon with a

C3.name: 14th Political Prison
C3.label: Major Location
C3.text: Walled plateau with a watchtower on every corner and the Y-shaped Citadel in the yard. The Warden holds the mess hall with a riot shield.

H8.text: Climb it and use the terminal at the top to mark the nearest Lieutenant on your map. A DMZ Order on page 2 asks for one.

H8.name: UAV Tower
H8.label: UAV Tower
H8.text: Activate it for a side op, DMZ Cash and a pulse that reveals nearby Operators and enemies. The Scout trait Overwatch keeps it running.

I4.name: Haneul Nuclear Reactor
I4.label: Major Location
I4.text: Reactor island with heavy radiation, worst inside the facility. Bring radiation gear and a gas mask. The Chemist spawns here and Operation Fallen Ember goes inside.

I4.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
I4.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
I4.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

I4.name: Marine Gas Station
I4.label: Gas Station
I4.text: Jetty with two pumps to repair and refuel boats.

I4.name: The Chemist's Secure Armory
I4.label: Key and Intel
I4.text: Lieutenant The Chemist's room: the right hand one of two bunker doors along the north reactor road by the boathouse. The left door is free. Rifle case, crate and two weapon lockers.

I5.name: Hazard Storehouse
I5.label: Key and Intel
I5.text: Opens the storage shed next to the SAM site on the south side of the reactor island. Up to eleven lockers with grenades and chemical cabinets were reported. Sources disagree on the grid, I4, I5 or I7,

I6.name: Gas Station
I6.label: Gas Station
I6.text: Repair and refuel cars and helicopters, and fill Gas Cans. A DMZ Order on page 8 sends you to one.

I6.name: Gun Store Weapons Locker (north Songdo Wharf)
I6.label: Key and Intel
I6.text: Opens one of the three green weapons lockers in a gun store basement. There are two gun stores: west Cheongun Village, across the street from the police station, and north Songdo Wharf, the shop with

I7.name: Songdo Wharf
I7.label: Major Location
I7.text: Quiet wharf on the east side of Hajin City, between the reactor and the south fork of the river.

I7.name: UAV Tower
I7.label: UAV Tower
I7.text: Activate it for a side op, DMZ Cash and a pulse that reveals nearby Operators and enemies. The Scout trait Overwatch keeps it running.

I7.name: Ammo and Armor Cache
I7.label: Ammo and Armor Cache
I7.text: Refill your ammo and pick up armor plates. The cache needs a cooldown after you use it.

I7.name: Marine Gas Station
I7.label: Gas Station
I7.text: Jetty with two pumps to repair and refuel boats.

I7.name: Bank Branch Vault Access (north Songdo Wharf)
I7.label: Key and Intel
I7.text: The keycard for the vault of a Hanex Bank branch. It spawns inside the bank. Put a car battery in the sparking power panel, swipe the card at the vault door, then enter the four digit code: a note in

I7.name: Old Barber Shop
I7.label: Key and Intel
I7.text: Opens the old barber shop next to the crab stall on the south side of Songdo Wharf. Weapon cases and armor boxes were reported.

lieutenants.where: Re-Education Center in Deadtown

lieutenants.name: The Chemist
lieutenants.where: Haneul Nuclear Reactor, inside the radiation zone. Bring a gas mask or a hazmat suit

lieutenants.name: The Doctor
lieutenants.where: Mirae General Hospital, in the parking garage

lieutenants.name: Gorani
lieutenants.where: In the forest south of Cheonwang Peak Array. Throws smoke, seems to teleport and places decoys

lieutenants.name: Iskra
lieutenants.where: Cheonwang Peak Array

lieutenants.name: Jang-ui
lieutenants.where: Netshin Tech Complex, on the 15th floor

lieutenants.name: Jin-Tae
lieutenants.where: Heavenly Luck Casino in Cheongun Village

lieutenants.name: Roze
lieutenants.where: DBN Headquarters in The Grid

lieutenants.name: The Scavenger
lieutenants.where: Hajin River Heights

lieutenants.where: 14th Political Prison, in the mess hall. Fights with a riot shield

poi_threat.name: Haneul Nuclear Reactor
poi_threat.threat_raw: High with radiation, Border Zone Medium

14th Political Prison.text: High, Citadel Critical. A walled prison on a cleared plateau in the North Korean wilderness, with a watchtower on every corner. The Y-shaped Citadel in the yard runs at Critical, and the Warden guards the mess hall with a riot shield.

Chang-san Air Base.text: Critical, bunker Extreme. A North Korean air base built into a granite hillside on the west side of Hajin. Admin Complex No. 2 sits at its heart, three SAM Sites guard it, and the underground bunker below runs at Extreme. Our

Deadtown.text: Low, Re-Education Center Medium. An abandoned farming town in the southwest, with toxic rivers on two sides. The town itself is Low threat, but the Re-Education Center on its east side is Medium and is where Bale spawns. You also find a clinic, a bounty station and a Lieutenant Hunt Tower here.

Imjin Farmland.text: Low, Rice Mill Medium. Rice fields, farms, narrow roads and rail lines on the border between North and South. The Rice Mill in D8 towers over the fields and runs at Medium. Imjin Farmland is also a Multiplayer Combat Outpost map.

Cheongun Village.text: Low, Heavenly Luck Casino High. The northernmost South Korean village, split by the border crossing to Russia. The village is Low threat, but the Heavenly Luck Casino in its center is High, and Jin-Tae spawns there.

Mirae General Hospital.text: Low. The main hospital of Hajin, next to a train station between Cheongun Village and Hajin City, with triage tents and barracks on its grounds. The Doctor waits in the parking garage.

Cheonwang Peak Array.text: Medium. The biggest telecom array in Hajin, on a flat summit in the middle of the map with forest and huge boulders around it. Iskra holds the array, and Gorani roams the woods to the south.

Haneul Nuclear Reactor.text: High with radiation, Border Zone Medium. A reactor island in the northeast with severe radiation that gets worse inside the facility. Bring radiation gear and a gas mask. The Chemist spawns in the radiation zone, and

NuriGO Mall.text: Mall High, NuriGO West Medium. A shopping district in the north of Hajin City with a big underground mall. There is no power below ground, so bring NVGs. The mall is High threat, NuriGO West is Medium, and we ran into the Deathstalker Commander around here.

The Grid.text: Critical, DBN and Netshin Extreme. The walled business district in the center of Hajin City and the toughest area on the map. It holds DBN Headquarters (Roze), the Netshin Tech Complex (Jang-ui on the 15th floor), the Hanex Bank tower and Hotel Lucera. DBN and Netshin run at Extreme, and

Songdo Wharf.text: Low. The east side of Hajin City, from the reactor down to the south fork of the river. It is Low threat. La Grande Vie, in H7, has the antenna mast that a DMZ Order on page 8 asks you to place a transmitter on.

Wolves Stadium.text: Medium. The baseball stadium district in the south of Hajin City, with a police station and Compound Echo nearby. Wolves Stadium is also a Multiplayer Combat Outpost map.

Hajin River Heights.text: Medium. Apartment blocks and narrow shopping streets in the south of Hajin City, badly hit in the fighting. The Scavenger spawns here.

The Citadel.text: The Y-shaped block in the yard of the 14th Political Prison, with gantries, cell blocks and a furnace. The Warden guards the mess hall.

Where Is the Heavenly Luck Casino?.text: The Heavenly Luck Casino is in Cheongun Village, grid F4, on the north side of the map near the border crossing to Russia. It is a multi-floor casino with gambling halls and an underground car park without power, so bring NVGs. Jin-Tae spawns here, and a DMZ Order asks you to mark 10 enemies inside with a Recon Drone.

Admin Complex No. 2.text: The fortified core of Chang-san Air Base, above a bunker that runs at Extreme.

Re-Education Center.text: Bale’s stronghold on the east side of Deadtown, a step up from the rest of the town.

Rice Mill.text: The industrial mill that towers over Imjin Farmland and gives a long view across the fields. Approach through the warehouses for cover. Mirae General Hospital and NuriGO Mall count as strongholds too. Their sections are above. Each of the ten Lieutenants has a home area, and these are the spots where we found them. Commanders such as the Colossus roam, so they are not on the map.

MW4 DMZ 3D Printer Recipes: Every Craftable Item
MW4 DMZ 3D Printer Recipes: Every Craftable Item
Every MW4 DMZ 3D Printer recipe we have captured, with exact ingredients, rarity and unlock route, from starter gear and upgrades to Ultra blueprints.

The 3D Printer in MW4 DMZ unlocks at DMZ level 2 and prints almost everything you carry into Hajin, from armor vests and backpacks to medical items, tacticals, lethals, field upgrades, fire support, gear and even the ingredients for other recipes. Our list covers every printer card we have captured so far, 107 in total, with exact ingredients, rarity and how each one unlocks. Recipes open up by DMZ level, DMZ Orders, a Story Mission, or by finding the recipe during a deployment.

The original DMZ had nothing like this, and it is one of the coolest additions in MW4 DMZ. The flip side is the top end. The best vests, backpacks and fire support need a recipe you find in the world, and even with that recipe in hand, the ingredient bill is steep.
Unlock: the 3D Printer opens at DMZ level 2. Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades and Fire Support follow at DMZ level 4, 7, 12 and 28.
Resources: most recipes use Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals or Metals, plus rarer ingredients you loot or print. Every Legendary and Ultra recipe runs on ingredients only.
Blueprints: 46 of the 107 cards say “Find this recipe in game to unlock”.
Ingredient printing: Uncommon Ingredient Printing costs $50,000, Epic Ingredient Printing $100,000, both plus rare parts.
Ultra tier: 8 recipes, from the Tempered Armor Vest to Crossfire, all found in game.
The Ingredient Ladder and Ingredient Printing
Every 3D Printer Recipe in MW4 DMZ
Recipes You Unlock With DMZ Level
How the MW4 DMZ 3D Printer Works
The 3D Printer is one of the stations in the

, the hub you return to between deployments. It unlocks at DMZ level 2, which is its own progression next to your MW4 player level. The unlock text promises Gear, Backpacks, Consumables and Upgrades, and in practice that covers nearly everything. You are not just crafting a few gadgets, you are building your whole kit.

The printer screen sorts recipes into Tracked, Upgrades, Consumables, Plate Carriers, Backpacks, Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades, Fire Support, Gear and Ingredients. Four of those categories stay locked at first. Tacticals open at DMZ level 4, Lethals at 7, Field Upgrades at 12 and Fire Support at 28.
The 3D Printer menu with every recipe category on the left.
Most recipes are built from four

, namely Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals and Metals. Looted resource items such as Scissors or an Infrared Thermometer, and the containers you open, feed those four totals. If you run the Scout tree, its starting trait Resource Pockets gives you 20% more printer resources from scrapped items.

, named parts with their own rarity. Uncommon ones include Biomaterials, Control Unit, Detonators, Electronic Sensors, Reactive Metals and Rigid Synthetics. Rare ones include Binding Catalyst, CPU, Nitro Compounds, Printed Circuit Board, Stock Rod, Structural Alloy, High-Tenacity Fibers and Nylon Cloth. Hover any ingredient and its tooltip lists the recipes it goes into, which makes it easy to decide what to keep.
Detonators from a tool box, with the recipes it is used in.
The Binding Catalyst tooltip in the stash.

How 3D Printer Recipes Unlock in MW4 DMZ
The line under each recipe tells you how to unlock it. We counted every card in our data, and finding the recipe in the world is by far the most common route.
Energy Drink, Claymore, Trophy System, Tempered Armor Vest
Sedative Inhaler (3), Frag Grenade (7), Armor Box (14), Self-Revive Kit (48)
Bandage, 1-Plate Armor Vest, Small Backpack, Bank Upgrade I
C4, Flash, Recon Drone, DDOS, Night Vision Goggles, 3-Plate Armor Vest
Dog Tag Case, Gunsmith and Vendor upgrades
Bank Upgrade II, Bank Upgrade III, MIA Recovery Discount III
We call the found recipes blueprints, and they are where the good stuff lives. The single Story Mission recipe is the Defibrillator, which you get by finishing
Extracting with a recipe you looted also pays out. One of our extractions paid $5,000 for the recipe on top of the cash we banked.
The Ingredient Ladder and Ingredient Printing
Ingredients are not only loot. Two upgrades in the Upgrades tab let the printer make them for you, and they form a ladder.
Biomaterials, Control Unit, Detonators, Electronic Sensors, Reactive Metals, Rigid Synthetics
$100,000, 10 Binding Catalyst, 10 Printed Circuit Board, 5 Military Composites
Alloyed Plating, Ballistic Fabric, Comms Module, Nylon Laminate, Power Regulator, Stabilized Reagents, Turned Components, Volatile Explosives
100 of one basic resource + 3 of a Rare part

Look closely at the Uncommon upgrade. It asks for 5 Comms Module, and Comms Module is an Epic ingredient you can only print after the Epic upgrade. So in practice you loot those first. The Epic upgrade in turn wants Military Composites, and we found no printer recipe for that one.

The Rare tier is the gap in the ladder. None of the Rare ingredients (Binding Catalyst, CPU, Printed Circuit Board, Stock Rod and the rest) has a printer recipe in our data. Every Epic ingredient needs 3 of one of them, so Rare parts are what we hunt for on every deployment.
Uncommon Ingredient Printing needs Comms Module, an Epic part.
Epic Ingredient Printing costs $100,000 plus three ingredients.
Every 3D Printer Recipe in MW4 DMZ

MW4 DMZ Boss Board: Every Lieutenant Location and Reward
MW4 DMZ Boss Board: Every Lieutenant Location and Reward
Every MW4 DMZ Lieutenant and Commander: where they spawn, how they fight, what they pay, and how intel, Hunt Towers and Lieutenant dog tags work.

The MW4 DMZ Boss Board is the FOB station that tracks every boss on Hajin: 10 Lieutenants and 3 Commanders. A Lieutenant pays $10,000 and a Commander $50,000 the first time you take them down, and every Lieutenant drops a dog tag worth $25,000 on extract. This guide shows where each boss spawns, how they fight, what they pay and how intel, Hunt Towers and Lieutenant dog tags work.
The Boss Board unlocks once you finish your second page of DMZ Orders.
There are 10 Lieutenants with a fixed home area and 3 Commanders who roam the map.
Board rewards are paid once per boss: $10,000 for a Lieutenant, $50,000 for a Commander.
Every Lieutenant drops a Legendary dog tag. Extract it for $25,000 and 1,000 XP, but it shows your position to every other squad.
Buy intel for $25,000 to hunt the Lieutenant you want, or use a free Lieutenant Hunt Tower to find the nearest one.

What the Boss Board Is and How to Unlock It

The Boss Board stands in a tent at your FOB. It has two tabs. The Lieutenants tab holds a card for each of the 10 Lieutenants, with their reward, a kill counter, a dog tag counter and the button to buy intel. The Commanders tab holds the three Commanders, with their reward and a kill counter. Once you take a boss down, its reward changes to Claimed.

The board unlocks through DMZ Orders, not your DMZ level. Finish your second page of orders and it opens as the third page starts. That happened for us at DMZ level 16 in one run and at level 6 in another. Our

The intel column shows when you can buy intel on that Lieutenant. Some cards keep a padlock until you finish certain DMZ Orders chapters.
All 10 Lieutenants and How They Fight

Lieutenants are named bosses with a few soldiers around them. When you get close, a banner with their name and area appears and a side op tells you to kill them. Most of them go down like a tough soldier. The danger is usually the area they sit in.

The Warden holds the mess hall of the 14th Political Prison, a High threat area. He pushes forward behind a riot shield, so flank him or wait for him to expose himself, and bring more ammo than you think. He dropped his Type 73 with a camo on it for us.

Bale sits at the Re-Education Center in Deadtown. The Operation Iron Citadel briefing calls him the Lieutenant of Chang-san Air Base, and the armory notes in that mission are signed by him, but in the field we found him in Deadtown. His intel opens once you finish the Underground, Counterfeit and Human Intel chapters.
Jin-Tae spawns at the Heavenly Luck Casino in Cheongun Village. His paid intel led us to the casino in two separate matches.
The Doctor wears a white hazmat suit and a gas mask. He showed up in the parking garage of Mirae General Hospital while we were running the
Dynamic Op, and a side op to kill him appeared on the spot.

The Chemist sits deep in the radiation zone of the Haneul Nuclear Reactor. He has a few soldiers around him and no special tricks, but the radiation fog cuts your vision and without a gas mask or hazmat suit you do not last there. Gear up before you buy his intel. Ours also dropped an Epic Kastov 762. Our
Iskra holds Cheonwang Peak Array. We ran into her while running the

Gorani is the tricky one. He hides in the forest south of Cheonwang Peak Array, not in a building. He throws a lot of smoke, seems to teleport, and puts down decoy dummies, so check what you are shooting at before you burn your ammo. His intel opens once you finish the Underground, Counterfeit and Human Intel chapters.
Jang-ui is high up in Netshin Tech Complex in The Grid, an Extreme threat area. He fights among the server rooms on the 15th floor, so take the elevator or stairs up with your plates full.
Roze holds DBN Headquarters in The Grid, another Extreme area. Her intel opens once you finish the Underground chapter. Her name is also on
that opens the armory in Netshin Tech Complex next door.
The Scavenger is at Hajin River Heights. Our fight with him moved through Wolves Stadium before he went down at Hajin River Heights, so expect him to move.
Commanders are the big bosses. They are not tied to one spot, they pay $50,000 once on the board, and they carry the rarest 3D Printer ingredients.
Anywhere on Hajin. We met him in the North Korean Wilderness and the Chang-san Air Base Bunker

Bring a full kit. A 3-Plate vest, plenty of armor plates and more ammo than you think, because he soaks up a lot of damage.
Stay in cover while his minigun spins and shoot back in the pause between bursts.
Focus fire as a squad. Pick one teammate to call when he stops firing and everyone shoots at once.
Clear the soldiers around him first, so you can take your time on Colossus himself.
Loot him when he goes down. He carries Military Composites and can drop Ultra gear.

The Commanders tab. Each pays $50,000 once.
Boss Rewards: Cash, XP and Drops
Once per Lieutenant, paid on extract
Every time you extract with one

The $10,000 Lieutenant reward is not paid at the moment of the kill. It shows up on the after-action report as First Lieutenant Takedowns, so you only get it if you extract. Kill the same Lieutenant again and the board reward does not come back, but the dog tag still pays $25,000.

Bosses also drop weapons. The Warden left us his Type 73 and the Chemist a Kastov 762, and Colossus dropped Ultra gear. A single Commander pays half of the $100,000 bank you start with, which makes them the best cash on the board.
How to Find a Lieutenant: Intel and Hunt Towers

Select a Lieutenant on the Boss Board and buy their intel for $25,000. When you deploy, a side op called Paid Intel: Reach (name) appears with a ping on the tac map. Once you get close it changes to Paid Intel: Kill (name). After you have bought intel once, every other open card offers a free swap, so you can move it to a different Lieutenant without paying again. You can also buy intel on a Lieutenant you already killed, to farm their dog tag.
The free way is a Lieutenant Hunt Tower, covered below.
After buying intel once, swapping it is free.
A Lieutenant Hunt Tower at Tong-il Village, D3.
Lieutenant Hunt Towers: How They Work and Where They Are

Lieutenant Hunt Towers are tall radio towers spread over Hajin, with a terminal at the top. They are the free way to find a Lieutenant, and the DMZ Orders task Locate and Climb a Hunt Lieutenant Tower on the Human Intel chapter sends you to one. The Warfighter trait LT Hunter reveals an additional Lieutenant when you activate a tower. Our
Get close to a tower. A side op called Climb the Lieutenant Hunt Tower appears by itself.
Climb the tower to the platform at the top.
Use the terminal there to download the intel. The side op becomes Reach the Lieutenant’s Location and the nearest Lieutenant is marked on your tac map.
Head to the marker. When you get close, the Lieutenant’s banner appears and the side op turns into a kill order.

The tower always picks the nearest Lieutenant, so you cannot choose who you hunt. To go after one specific Lieutenant, buy their intel on the Boss Board instead. We used towers at Tong-il Village (D3), in the south of Deadtown (B7) and on South Island. The same towers are the radio towers for the Triangulation order on page 8 of our
Lieutenant Dog Tags and the Boss Board Challenges
Every Lieutenant drops a Legendary dog tag with their name, a $25K bounty, your name as the killer and the time of death. Extract with it for $25,000 and 1,000 XP.
Carrying a Lieutenant’s dog tag shows your position on the tac map to every other operator. Plan your exfil before you pick it up, and head there instead of looting more.
The dog tags also drive the three challenges on the Lieutenants tab.
Kill Challenge. Kill all 10 Hajin Lieutenants once.
Dog Tag Challenge. Extract the dog tags of all 10 Lieutenants 2 times.
Dog Tag Challenge 2. Extract them all 5 times.

Each challenge counts Lieutenants, not attempts, so you need all ten. A tag your squadmate extracts also counted on our own card. The final reward shows as a skull trinket, and we have not seen what it is yet.
Lieutenant dog tags are not the same as Operator Dog Tags, which come from other players, or the Dog Tag rank of your own operator. Our
explains the Dog Tag Case and the bounty payout boosts.
A Lieutenant dog tag. Worth $25,000 if you get it out.
How do you unlock the Boss Board in MW4 DMZ?
Finish your second page of DMZ Orders. The Boss Board unlocks as the third page starts, whatever your DMZ level. It opened for us once at DMZ level 16 and once at DMZ level 6.
How many Lieutenants are there in MW4 DMZ?
Ten. The Warden, Bale, Jin-Tae, The Doctor, The Chemist, Iskra, Gorani, Jang-ui, Roze and The Scavenger. On top of them there are three Commanders, Colossus, Deathstalker and the Tank.
Where do the Lieutenants spawn in MW4 DMZ?

Each Lieutenant has a home area. The Warden is at the 14th Political Prison, Bale at the Re-Education Center in Deadtown, Jin-Tae at the Heavenly Luck Casino, The Doctor at Mirae General Hospital, The Chemist at the Haneul Nuclear Reactor, Iskra at Cheonwang Peak Array, Gorani in the forest south of Cheonwang Peak Array, Jang-ui on the 15th floor of Netshin Tech Complex, Roze at DBN Headquarters and The Scavenger at Hajin River Heights.
How much do bosses pay on the MW4 DMZ Boss Board?
A Lieutenant pays $10,000 and a Commander $50,000, once per boss, for your first takedown. A Lieutenant's dog tag pays another $25,000 and 1,000 XP every time you extract with it.
How do you find a Lieutenant in MW4 DMZ?

Buy their intel on the Boss Board for $25,000, which gives you a side op that leads you straight to that Lieutenant. The free way is a Lieutenant Hunt Tower, but its terminal points you at the nearest Lieutenant, so you do not get to choose.
Where is Colossus in MW4 DMZ?

Colossus is a Commander and has no fixed spot. He can show up anywhere on Hajin. We met him in the North Korean Wilderness and in the Chang-san Air Base Bunker, and he is one of the two bosses at the end of Operation Fallen Ember.
Where are the Lieutenant Hunt Towers in MW4 DMZ?

Hunt Towers are tall radio towers with a terminal at the top, spread over Hajin. We used the ones at Tong-il Village (D3), in the south of Deadtown (B7) and on South Island. Get close and the Climb the Lieutenant Hunt Tower side op appears. Use the terminal at the top and the nearest Lieutenant is marked on your map.
How do you kill Colossus in MW4 DMZ?

Bring a 3-Plate vest, extra plates and lots of ammo. Colossus fires his minigun in bursts, so stay in cover while he fires and shoot back as a squad in the pause between bursts. Clear the soldiers around him first.
Is a Lieutenant dog tag the same as the Dog Tag rank?
No. A Lieutenant dog tag is an item a Lieutenant drops, which you extract for cash and the Boss Board challenges. The Dog Tag rank (Steel up to Onyx) is the level of your own operator.

MW4 DMZ Orders: Every Page, Task and Reward
MW4 DMZ Orders: Every Page, Task and Reward
Every MW4 DMZ Orders page from 1 to 15, each order as the game lists it, a quick tip and the rewards, plus a map of Lost Supply Drop spots.

DMZ Orders are the progression track of MW4 DMZ. Every page holds three orders, every finished page pays $20,000 plus gear or recipes, and the pages unlock parts of your FOB along the way. Below is every page we have unlocked, with each order exactly as the game lists it, a short tip and the rewards. We add new pages as we unlock them.
Open DMZ Orders at the terminal in your FOB. Each page has three orders, and you finish the whole page to move on.
Every page pays $20,000 plus items, recipes or a survival kit.
Page 1 is the tutorial. After that you choose a chapter: Human Intel, Underground or Counterfeit. Each chapter has 2 pages and ends with a story mission.
Finishing your second page unlocks the Boss Board.
Some rewards feed the next page. The Flash recipe is what you print for Blindness, and the Recon Drone recipe is what you print for Eyes Everywhere.
Page 1: Gear Up, Crackshot, First Op
DMZ Orders live on a terminal in your

, and the active page also shows in a panel on screen while you play. Each page holds three orders with one to three tasks each. Progress counts as you go, but the page only pays out once all three orders are done. Several orders ask you to print something, and the 3D Printer opens its categories at different DMZ levels. Our
shows what each level unlocks, so check the printer before you deploy for a print order.
After page 1 you pick one of three chapters, Human Intel, Underground or Counterfeit. Each has 2 pages and 6 orders, and its last order is a story mission,
is the last mission on the story mission tree, and it opens once you have finished both of those.

After page 11 you choose a chapter again, this time between The Grid and Hornet’s Nest. Both have 2 pages and 6 orders. The Grid ends with Operation Grid Assault, and Hornet’s Nest ends with Operation Iron Citadel, which pays a Supreme Leader’s Bunker Access Card, and its chapter rewards list a Large Backpack recipe, a Weapon Restock Kit, a Helmeted Armor Kit, an Operator Rescue Beacon and $20,000 twice. We picked The Grid first, so page 12 below is The Grid 1/2.
After page 11 you pick between The Grid and Hornet's Nest.

Pages 1, 4, 7 and 10 have no chapter and are the same for everyone, and pages 11, 14 and 15 have no chapter either. The chapters fill pages 2 and 3, 5 and 6, and 8 and 9, in the order you pick them. We checked this against a teammate who played Counterfeit first. Pages 4 and 7 matched ours exactly, and Counterfeit and Human Intel asked for and paid the same things on their pages.

New orders and story missions arrive as video calls on the DMZ Orders panel. Accept the call and the caller briefs you on what comes next. Most calls come from the CIA Operator. Grigory, the pilot who flies the exfil helicopters, calls too, and sometimes his call offers you an op. When nothing new is ready, the panel tells you it is waiting for new orders.
The DMZ Orders terminal at the FOB.

Equip a Weapon, a Backpack, an Armor Vest, and a Medkit from Your Stash
Do it at the Stash in your FOB.
The Firing Range is in the FOB.
Deploy to DMZ in Dynamic Ops
Deploying is enough, you do not have to extract.
Locate and Climb a Hunt Lieutenant Tower
Use the Terminal at the Top to Locate the Nearest Lieutenant
Lieutenant Hunt Towers have their own icon on the tac map. One stands at Tong-il Village, grid D3, and our
shows all five. You only need the terminal, not the kill. Our
Clinics have a building icon with a cross. One sits in Deadtown at B7, and our
shows all eight. Chemical storage cabinets are the quickest source of Chemicals.
Loot Dropped Medical Extraction Intel Found After Clearing a Compound
Pick up a Clear the Military Compound side op. The intel drops once the compound is cleared. Compounds have a house icon with a flag, and our
shows all six, Alpha to Foxtrot.
Compound at G7, by Wolves Stadium.
The Flash recipe comes from the previous page. Print all four before you deploy.
Earn $11500 Cash From Completing Dynamic Ops
Phones spawn in different places every match. Look for the Dynamic Op icons on your tac map and ping one to see exactly where it is and how high up, as our
guide to collecting a Dynamic Op phone
explains. Activating it counts for the first task, and two finished Dynamic Ops covered the cash for us. See our
Complete the Operation Critical Extraction story mission
If you already finished it, the order ticks itself. Our
Collect a Dynamic Op Phone in Cheongun Village

The phone has to be one in Cheongun Village. Phones spawn in different places every match, so open your tac map, find a Dynamic Op icon inside Cheongun Village and ping it. The ping shows exactly where the phone is and how high up. Our
shows what a phone looks like. The crate at the end of any Dynamic Op counts for the last task.
Both are on the 3D Printer from the start. Our

Kill 8 Enemies in a Row Without Being Damaged
The streak resets when you take damage, so pick off AI soldiers from cover with that suppressed weapon.
Locate and Enter a Police Station
Search 3 Containers in a Police Station
Eliminate 5 Soldiers While Inside a Police Station
Police stations have a shield icon. There are five on Hajin, including H5 next to NuriGO Mall and G7 by Wolves Stadium. Our
shows all five with their grids.
Police station at H5, NuriGO Mall.
Police station at G7, Wolves Stadium.
Open a Safe (Often Found in Compounds and Locked Spaces)
Extract $5000 Total Backpack and Loadout Value
The $5,000 counts your backpack and loadout together, so one normal run covers it.
Hack a UAV Tower in Deadtown
Kill 5 NK Soldiers Pinged by a UAV Tower
Loot Counterfeit Cash Dropped by Pinged NK Soldiers
How to Loot Counterfeit Cash Dropped by Pinged NK Soldiers

Hack the UAV tower in Deadtown first. The hack pings the NK soldiers around it, and only those pinged soldiers count for the other two tasks. Kill five of them, then check their bodies. One of the pinged soldiers drops a backpack with the Counterfeit Cash, and looting it completes the order. Ours went down inside the Re-Education Center in Deadtown, B7. Hacking the tower also completes an Activate UAV Tower side op, and our
Kill 15 Enemies in Hazmat Suits (Often Found in Irradiated Areas)
Hazmat soldiers stay around radiation, such as the Haneul Nuclear Reactor. Bring a gas mask.
Mark 10 Enemies in the Heavenly Luck Casino With a Recon Drone
The Recon Drone recipe comes from the previous page and costs 30 Metals and 3 Electronic Sensors. Loot every IT bag and computer for the sensors, and see our
Complete the Operation Silent Ledger Story Mission
It also takes place in the Heavenly Luck Casino, so you can combine it with Eyes Everywhere. See our
Kill 15 Enemies With an Unsuppressed Weapon in a High Threat Level Location
Use a weapon without a suppressor and go to a High threat area. Kills in Critical and Extreme areas count too. Our counter climbed in The Citadel, and again at DBN Headquarters in The Grid during
Loot 3 Gas Masks or Radiation Pill Bottles
Fire stations have their own icon, and one is in Hanrim Village at C2. Our
shows all six. For the other two tasks, the Haneul Nuclear Reactor is the fastest place. Enemies there drop gas masks and radiation pills turn up quickly.
Fire station in Hanrim Village, C2.
Track the Medkit Recipe in the 3D Printer
A Medkit costs 30 Chemicals, 1 Binding Catalyst and 5 Biomaterials.
Shoot Down a Chopper Carrying Cargo With a SAM Site
Loot a Crate From a Downed Chopper
SAM sites have their own map icon and a Capture SAM Site side op. Capture one at the laptop on the launcher. A downed cargo chopper drops a Care Package crate.
Refuel and Repair a Vehicle at a Gas Station
Run Over 7 Enemies in a Vehicle
Drive onto a gas station and stay in the car while it refuels and repairs. One is in Hanrim Village, next to Revolution Dam.

MW4 DMZ Operation Critical Extraction Walkthrough
MW4 DMZ Operation Critical Extraction Walkthrough
MW4 DMZ Operation Critical Extraction walkthrough. Find General Kang in Mirae General Hospital, push his bed to the roof and onto the exfil chopper.

Operation Critical Extraction is the chapter-ending Story Mission of Ch. Human Intel in MW4 DMZ. You fight into Mirae General Hospital on Hajin, find General Kang in a hospital bed, push that bed to the elevators and up to the roof, and secure him in the exfil chopper. We cleared it with our squad on October 20, 2026, the first day of DMZ early access, before DMZ opened to everyone with the
). From deploy to mission complete it took about eight minutes on the radiation countdown.
Location: Mirae General Hospital. Threat assessment Medium, recommended gear a 2-Plate Armor Vest and a Medkit.
Steps: Approach the Hospital, Find General Kang, Move Gen. Kang to Safety, Wait for the Elevators to Open, Secure Gen. Kang in the Exfil Chopper.
The enemies are regular soldiers, not elites. Running out of ammo is the real risk, so bring extra and grab weapons from the bodies.

Rewards: a Mirae Electrical Room key, a Defibrillator and cash. The mission promises $25,000 before you deploy, but the extraction summary paid us a $5,000 Story Mission Payout, so check your Bank before and after.
Operation Critical Extraction at a Glance
How to Start Operation Critical Extraction
Operation Critical Extraction at a Glance
Locate the HVT, Eliminate any Resistance, Extract the HVT
Mirae Electrical Room key x1, Defibrillator, $25,000 promised ($5,000 paid out for us)
The briefing only tells you that an HVT is recovering in the hospital and that you need to find out why the enemy was protecting him. That HVT turns out to be General Kang.
The mission details screen, with the Accept Mission button.
How to Start Operation Critical Extraction

Open Select Deployment, choose Story Missions, and pick Operation Critical Extraction from the mission list. It is the chapter-ending Story Mission of Ch. Human Intel, a chapter with 2 pages and 6 DMZ Orders. Our
lists every order in that chapter.
You do not need to finish the chapter’s orders first. We ran the mission with the chapter’s first page (Human Intel 1/2) still open, with Hunter untouched and Triage Protocol at 6 of 30 Chemicals.
Ch. Human Intel ends with Operation Critical Extraction.
These are the exact objective texts the game showed us, in order.
You spawn on a wooded hillside at Expressway No. 1. The waypoint sat 322 meters away down a dirt track in our run, so it is a short trip to the hospital.
The mission starts about 320 meters from the hospital.

Inside, the hospital is tagged Low threat. Fight through the elevator hall and the wards toward the marker. We had eliminated 14 enemies by the time we reached Kang, who lies in a bed in a dim patient room.
Open the green Medical Bags on the way. They gave us Chemicals, a Bandage and Biomaterials, which covers part of the Triage Protocol order from the same chapter.
The elevator hall on the way to Kang.
Search the wards. The marker leads you to him.
General Kang, still in his hospital bed.
Kang does not walk. Stand behind his bed and push it out of the room and through the corridors, past the Operating Room. Enemies keep coming from the doorways ahead, so the pusher needs cover.
Expect enemies in the doorways along the route.
4. Wait for the Elevators to Open

Park the bed at the elevators in the lobby. A progress bar starts filling, and this is where the enemies push hardest. Our elimination count went from 15 at the Operating Room to 28 by the time the timer started, and the side op “Secure Lost Supply Drop” popped up at the same moment. Ignore it until Kang is safe.
Hold the lobby until the elevator bar fills.
5. Secure Gen. Kang in the Exfil Chopper

Take the bed up to the hospital roof, where the exfil chopper waits on the helipad. Push the bed up the rear ramp into the cabin and the mission completes. We checked a cache in an office on the way up and found a CPU, so if your squad is comfortable it is worth a quick look.
Across the helipad to the open ramp.
Up the ramp and into the cabin.

The mission completes the moment Kang is inside the chopper, and it counted toward our story mission challenges too. From that point you choose. Ride out with Kang, or step off and keep playing the DMZ.
Mission complete, with the chopper ready to leave.

The enemies are not the problem. None of them were elites in our run, and the hospital is tagged Low once you are inside. The mission’s Medium threat rating oversells the fight. What actually hurts is the volume. We eliminated 41 enemies in total, and by the roof we were down to a Krait P68 pistol with four rounds left. We were completely dry by the time we sat in the chopper.

The elevator wait is the one spot where that catches up with you. You cannot move on until the bar fills, so hold the lobby, face the doors the enemies come through, and keep the bed out of the open. Agree on one player to push before each leg starts.

Do not walk in with only what is in your magazines. We started on an Incarcerator and had switched to a Han 86 by the elevators. Pick up weapons from the enemies you eliminate as you go, because there are plenty of them.
, a Defibrillator and cash. The mission promises $25,000 before you deploy, but the extraction summary paid us a $5,000 Story Mission Payout, so check your Bank before and after.
The XP side is clearer. The completed mission was worth 12,500 XP, our run rated B+, and it pushed us from DMZ level 3 to level 5. Our
shows what each of those levels unlocks. Finishing the mission also unlocks the Defibrillator in the 3D Printer, and our

lists what it costs to print. The Defibrillator also shows up in the CPU tooltip as one of the items a CPU goes into, so hang on to CPUs. The mission does not tell you what the Mirae Electrical Room key opens.
The extraction summary with the $5,000 Story Mission Payout.
12,500 XP for the mission and a B+ rating.
Separately, each of the two order pages of Ch. Human Intel pays its own rewards once all three of its orders are done:
First page (Human Intel 1/2): Flash recipe x1, $20,000 cash, Basic Triage Kit x1
Second page (Human Intel 2/2): UAV x3, $20,000 cash, Operator Rescue Beacon x1, Weapon Insurance Contract x1
lists every page reward for all three chapters.

Bring the recommended 2-Plate Armor Vest and Medkit, plus as much ammo as you can carry. We would also bring an Ammo Box field upgrade. When you run dry halfway through the elevator wait, you drop it and refill without leaving the bed.
Two good teammates make this easy. One pushes Kang while the other two clear ahead and watch the doors.
If you are new to the map, our
shows where Mirae General Hospital sits among the other points of interest. The other two chapters end with
, and we have walkthroughs for both. Finishing all three unlocks the two harder missions,
at the Haneul Nuclear Reactor, where the story ends. Between story missions, Dynamic Ops are the other way to earn cash and XP on Hajin, and our
covers every op and its rewards.
Where is Operation Critical Extraction in MW4 DMZ?

Operation Critical Extraction takes place at Mirae General Hospital on the Hajin map. You deploy on Expressway No. 1, about 320 meters from the hospital, and the HVT you need to extract is General Kang.
How do I start Operation Critical Extraction in DMZ?

Pick Story Missions under Select Deployment, then choose the mission from the mission list. It is the chapter-ending Story Mission of Ch. Human Intel. We started it while the first page of that chapter's orders was still unfinished.
How do I move General Kang's bed in MW4 DMZ?

Stand behind the hospital bed and push it. You push it through the hospital corridors, into the elevators, onto the roof and up the ramp of the exfil chopper. Let one player push while the rest of the squad clears enemies.
What are the rewards for Operation Critical Extraction?

Operation Critical Extraction rewards a Mirae Electrical Room key and a Defibrillator. The mission promises $25,000 before you deploy, but the extraction summary paid us a $5,000 Story Mission Payout, so check your Bank before and after. The mission itself is worth 12,500 XP.
Do I have to exfil with General Kang after the mission?
No. The mission completes once Kang is secured in the exfil chopper. You can ride out with him, or stay in the DMZ and keep playing.
Can I replay Operation Critical Extraction in MW4?

Once you finish it, the mission becomes eligible for Random Story Mission. That deployment runs at Medium to Extreme threat and requires squad fill. Completing three random Story Missions in a week also counts toward a weekly reward.
